财务报表类型。main_data: 主要指标，rnd: 研发支出，ttm: TTM

财务指标名称。main_data: adjusted_net_profit 扣非净利润，return_on_equity_weighted_average 加权平均净资产收益率。rnd: expensed_rnd 费用化研发支出，capitalized_rnd 资本化研发支出，total_rnd 研发支出合计，rnd_to_revenue 研发支出占营业收入比例，capitalized_rnd_ratio 资本化研发支出比重，rnd_employees 研发人员数量，rnd_employees_ratio 研发人员占比。ttm: operating_expenseTTM 销售费用，operating_costTTM 营业成本，net_invest_cashflowTTM 投资活动现金流量净额，sale_service_render_cashTTM 销售商品提供劳务收到的现金，ebitTTM 息税前利润，operating_revenueTTM 营业收入，operating_profitTTM 营业利润，ni_from_operatingTTM 经营活动净收益，net_cashflowTTM 现金及现金等价物净增加额，net_finance_cashflowTTM 筹资活动现金流量净额，net_operate_cashflowTTM 经营活动现金流量净额，operating_payoutTTM 营业支出，asset_impairment_lossTTM 资产减值损失，non_operating_net_incomeTTM 营业外收支净额，administration_expenseTTM 管理费用，gross_profitTTM 毛利，total_operating_costTTM 营业总成本，financial_expenseTTM 财务费用，ni_from_value_changeTTM 价值变动净收益，np_parent_company_ownersTTM 归母净利润，net_profitTTM 净利润，total_profitTTM 利润总额，total_operating_revenueTTM 营业总收入
